# CLAUDE.md

Conventions for AI-assisted development in this repository.

## Types must come from the OpenAPI-generated file

All SDK types must be derived from `src/models/custody-types.ts`, which is
generated by `npm run generate:custody-types` from the OpenAPI spec at
`openapi/Ripple-Custody-v1-OpenAPI.json`.

Reference the generated types via the two top-level exports:

- `operations["<operationId>"]["parameters"]["path" | "query"]` — request path
  and query param shapes
- `operations["<operationId>"]["requestBody"]["content"]["application/json"]` —
  request body shapes
- `operations["<operationId>"]["responses"][<status>]["content"]["application/json"]` —
  response shapes (when not already a named component)
- `components["schemas"]["<SchemaName>"]` — reusable response and body schemas

Example (from `src/services/events/events.types.ts`):

```ts
import type { components, operations } from "../../models/custody-types.js"

export type GetEventsPathParams = operations["getEvents"]["parameters"]["path"]
export type GetEventsQueryParams = operations["getEvents"]["parameters"]["query"]
export type Core_EventsCollection = components["schemas"]["Core_EventsCollection"]
```

## Do not hand-author types that duplicate or conflict with the generated file

Hand-written interfaces or type aliases that mirror OpenAPI schemas are not
allowed — they drift from the API contract and make the SDK lie about what the
server actually accepts and returns. If a needed shape is missing or wrong:

1. Update the OpenAPI spec at `openapi/Ripple-Custody-v1-OpenAPI.json`
2. Regenerate with `npm run generate:custody-types`
3. Re-export the updated type from `src/services/<area>/<area>.types.ts`

The only types that may be hand-authored are SDK-internal types that have no
API counterpart (for example, polling option bags like `WaitForExecutionOptions`,
or unions composed from existing generated types like `EDS_ChannelCreate`).
